text:
toni: Quick heads-up  we need a compact migration matrix for the v1->v2 swap that docs, SDK, and integrator guides can embed. Aim for a one-page table + examples.

ashley: I can make the matrix. Will include columns: legacy path, canonical v2 path, client surface change, model alias mapping, embed dim change, migration note.

rene: pls include an explicit "do not change" list for archived blog posts and partner integrations so we don't break old marketing links.

toni: good call. Also add a short section on expected CI checks and a sample grep rule: `grep -R "\/\/v1\/\|ResponsesClientV1\|embed-v1"` and suggested fixes.

ashley: sample snippet to include in the matrix for JS + Py migrations:

```js
// old
import { ResponsesClientV1 } from '@redwood/sdk'
const client = new ResponsesClientV1({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY })
await client.invoke({ model: 'chat-v1', input: 'hello' })

// new
import { ResponsesClient } from '@redwood/sdk'
const client = new ResponsesClient({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY })
await client.invoke({ model: 'chat-v2', input: 'hello' })
```

```py
# old
from redwood import ResponsesClientV1
c = ResponsesClientV1(api_key=os.getenv('RW_KEY'))
c.invoke(model='embed-v1-small', input='x')

# new
from redwood import ResponsesClient
c = ResponsesClient(api_key=os.getenv('RW_KEY'))
c.invoke(model='embed-lite-v2', input='x')
```

rene: add a short blurb on embeddings: "If embed dims change, re-index vector DBs or use a transformer adapter; do not mix vectors of different dims." Link to embeddings best-practices.

toni: CI plan: docs repo adds a lightweight lint step that fails when `/v1/` or `ResponsesClientV1` occur in non-whitelisted files. We'll ship whitelist as `_archived_whitelist.txt`. Also add a warning-only job for one week before making it blocking.

ci-bot: created docs CI job `v1-sweep` and opened PR #1502 with sample rules.

ashley: I'll draft the migration matrix and push in PR then tag SDK leads for snippet sync. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1506

docs-bot: linked PR #1506 to issue #501 "v1->v2 migration matrix & CI sweep" and assigned @toni @ashley @rene

toni: timeline: draft today, internal review tomorrow, publish migration page Thu, soft-lint enabled Fri, hard-block in 7 days. I'll post the announcement blurb after docs publish.

rene: I'll run a grep across `examples/` and `community/` and open fixes for anything flagged. Tagging infra team for help with archived redirects.

ashley: thanks all, will ping here with PR when ready :sparkles:
